main: ruleset: pull request required, status check er-check required, no bypass actors

observations.claim: A pull request that changes schema/schema.sql without regenerating docs/er.md fails the er-check job at 'git diff --exit-code'; mergeStateStatus is BLOCKED and a merge is refused ('the base branch policy prohibits the merge')
The same pull request passes once docs/er.md is regenerated
The first red run was an unresolvable action name (k1LoW/install-tbls-action), not staleness; the correct action is k1LoW/setup-tbls
A workflow with contents: write pushing the regenerated file to main is rejected: GH013 'Changes must be made through a pull request' and 'Required status check er-check is expected'
Opening a pull request with the built-in token fails by default: 'GitHub Actions is not permitted to create or approve pull requests'; the setting can_approve_pull_request_reviews was false

After enabling that setting the pull request opens; the er-check run for it is created with conclusion action_required and 0 jobs, so the PR has no check and stays BLOCKED until a person approves the run (POST /actions/runs/{id}/approve); after approval er-check ran and passed, and the PR merged
With has_wiki true, git ls-remote on <repo>.wiki.git answers 'Repository not found' until the first page is created in the web UI; afterwards it answers

A workflow with contents: write clones the wiki with the built-in token and pushes a page; no pull request, no ruleset change; the page renders the Mermaid block; no pull request check covers the page
upload-artifact stores docs/er.md and the SVG: 5935 bytes zipped, expires 90 days after the run, download URL answers 401 without credentials
POST /pages with build_type workflow enables Pages; a workflow with pages: write and id-token: write deployed an SVG; the URL answers 200 without credentials (the repository is public)
github.com renders the Mermaid block of docs/er.md as a diagram (images/er-diagram-from-schema-file/github-rendered.png)
